coverage: Actual local/global shaders publish exact pitched guarded MRT/depth source and resolve images and invalidate cached compute consumers
Empty frames and indexed instances retain every tile and reference; eight attributed fault cases each permit exact healthy reuse
GNX1 reports reader/frame/geometry stages, nested vertex faults and image fault tiles; healthy records clear invalid snapshots and compute records are zero
Reset retains live vertex payloads or a held image acknowledgement, discards queued DMA and old records, protects VM state, drains pins/allocations and permits exact reuse
Legacy typed graphics and AXI/MMIO routes retain their behavior; native and legacy completion/reset-edge races and simultaneous POP/replacement pass
limitations: This is GNC1 with trusted physical image views; the GNC2 permission-checked image profile is separate ongoing work
Physical allocation provenance and translated physical aliases remain enclosing allocation/lifetime responsibilities
Some child/pass failures provide no recorded address; stage and validity fields determine GNX1 interpretation
Runtime uses small frames/four lanes/two warps; full Mobile runtime/rates/budgets and all H0-H8 gates remain open
New color synthesis remains separate and unverified; no new Fmax, area, power, hold or place-and-route result is claimed
